definitions.gloss: articles of incorporation; company charter; bylaws
definitions.explanation: The foundational legal document of a corporation that sets out its purpose, structure, and rules of governance. Required when establishing a company in Japan.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{定款|ていかん}を{作成|さくせい}した。
examples.english: I drafted the company's articles of incorporation.

examples.japanese: {定款|ていかん}の{変更|へんこう}には{株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい}の{決議|けつぎ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Amending the articles of incorporation requires a resolution at the shareholders' meeting.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}{設立|せつりつ}の{際|さい}、{公証人|こうしょうにん}に{定款|ていかん}の{認証|にんしょう}を{受|う}けなければならない。
examples.english: When establishing a company, the articles of incorporation must be certified by a notary.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal and business term encountered when establishing or managing a corporation. The {定款|ていかん} is one of the essential documents required for company registration in Japan, along with other filings at the Legal Affairs Bureau.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定款|ていかん}を{作成|さくせい}する (to draft articles of incorporation)
- {定款|ていかん}の{認証|にんしょう} (certification of articles of incorporation)
- {定款|ていかん}を{変更|へんこう}する (to amend the articles of incorporation)
- {定款|ていかん}の{写|うつ}し (copy of the articles of incorporation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {規約|きやく}: rules, regulations (for organizations, associations)
- {社則|しゃそく}: company rules (internal regulations)
